build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm -w run prebuild:kill && pnpm --filter dlssync-frontend build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com https://s3.amazonaws.com https://cdn2.steamgriddb.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://api.github.com https://api.steampowered.com

bundle.shortDescription: Keep DLSS, FSR, and XeSS DLLs in sync with upstream
bundle.longDescription: DLSSync detects games installed via Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, Xbox, EA Desktop, and Battle.net, then keeps their DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, Streamline, FSR, and XeSS DLLs synchronized with the latest NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel upstream releases.
